drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: We agree these terms need to be defined before execution. The revised draft proposes schedules for the Shares, Purchase Price and covered financial statements, with the missing particulars expressly left for the parties to complete. It also proposes a 24-month claim period for the specified undisclosed-liability indemnity. Please send the company and capitalization details, proposed price and any adjustment methodology, and the annual and interim statements you would like identified in the schedules.

edits.text: 1. SHARES AND PURCHASE PRICE. At Closing, the Seller shall sell to the Buyer the shares identified by company, class, number and percentage in Schedule 1 (the “Shares”), and the Buyer shall pay the purchase price specified in Schedule 1 (the “Purchase Price”), subject only to any adjustment mechanism expressly set out there. Schedule 1 must be completed and agreed by the parties before execution.

3. FINANCIAL STATEMENTS. The Seller represents that the annual and interim financial statements identified in Schedule 2 have been prepared consistently in accordance with the applicable accounting standards specified in that Schedule and fairly present, in all material respects, the company’s financial position and results for the periods covered, subject, for interim statements, to normal year-end adjustments and the absence of notes, if so specified in Schedule 2. Schedule 2 must be completed and agreed by the parties before execution.

4. INDEMNITY. The Seller shall indemnify the Buyer against liabilities of the company existing at Closing to the extent they are not reflected or adequately reserved for in the financial statements identified in Schedule 2 and are not expressly disclosed in Schedule 3. The Buyer must give the Seller written notice describing a claim in reasonable detail within 24 months after Closing; a claim so notified may be pursued after that date. Schedule 3 must be completed and agreed by the parties before execution.
Open items for Schedule 1: company, share class, number and percentage; proposed Purchase Price; and whether any adjustment applies, including its calculation and dispute process.

Open items for Schedule 2: identify each annual and interim statement, its period and the applicable accounting standards. Confirm whether the proposed interim-statement qualifications are appropriate.

Open item for Schedule 3: list any liabilities expressly disclosed as exceptions to the indemnity. The proposed indemnity addresses liabilities existing at Closing; other limitations, if sought, remain for negotiation.
